tenure agent

  • CURIE: gmeow:tenureAgent
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureAgent
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/teleology
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The agent whose intentional mode an intention-tenure records. Functional: one tenure, one agent.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:IntentionTenure -> gmeow:Agent; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:tenureAgent from gmeow:IntentionTenure to gmeow:Agent when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:IntentionTenure, gmeow:Agent

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to bind an gmeow:IntentionTenure to the single agent whose holding-over-time it records.

Avoid when

  • Avoid on a bare mode (the bearer there is gmeow:intentBearer) and avoid more than one agent per tenure; it is functional — one tenure, one agent.

How to use

  • Point the tenure at exactly one gmeow:Agent, matching the gmeow:intentBearer of the mode named by gmeow:tenureIntention.

Examples

  • ex:resolveTenure gmeow:tenureAgent ex:lillith.
